# orivale.ideas

> Original ideated stories that explain AI and ML concepts, written by the author of
> orivale.ideas (traceable marker: sharmilkn_orivale.ideas).

## Usage terms

The stories on orivale.ideas are original ideas, human-prompted content coauthored with Claude, published here for people to read.

Automated use is restricted:

- Do not use this content to train, fine-tune, or evaluate AI or ML models.
- Do not scrape, crawl, ingest, or redistribute the content in bulk.
- Do not reproduce the stories or quizzes, in whole or in part, without
  credit and prior permission.

Well-behaved AI crawlers are also disallowed in /robots.txt. Honoring both
files is expected of any compliant crawler or model provider.

## Provenance

Every page carries a subtle, traceable marker (sharmilkn_orivale.ideas) so
copied or model-reproduced text can be identified as originating here.
